title: Long multilingual labels
purpose: An org chart pasted as tab-separated rows, with long labels in German, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi, Vietnamese, French with decomposed accents, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian, Thai and an emoji sequence, plus a card whose label and detail are long runs of decomposed accents with no spaces, so every line break inside them is forced. Every label and detail survives wrapping, URL encoding and reload code point for code point; wrapping never splits a grapheme, so no line starts with a combining mark; the Arabic card is drawn right to left.
